test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 22 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: P, Q, R, S and T are five friends sitting in a straight line facing North. P sits at the extreme right end. T sits to the immediate left of S but is not at the extreme left end. R is the immediate neighbour of P. Who sits at the extreme left end of the row?
solution:
Given: P, Q, R, S and T are five friends sitting in a straight line facing North.

1) P sits at the extreme right end.

2) R is the immediate neighbour of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd40649ecf99af24ae06ab490db06bae89d3e5e1a907ddec24724bcd66d8bb65.png] 

3) T sits to the immediate left of S but is not at the extreme left end.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1ef014fb1d684fa334584835314955c67d8f19de0f833384d99532a3bfb2b197.png] 

So, **Q** sits at the extreme left end of the row.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Q**".
